items.question: What is the duration of the flagship program?
items.answer: The flagship Advanced AI & Digital Marketing Program is 3 months of intensive practical training followed by a 3-month internship on live client work — 6 months total.

items.question: Do I need prior marketing experience?
items.answer: No. The flagship program is designed for beginners to job-ready professionals. We start with fundamentals and build up to advanced AI-integrated marketing.

items.question: Is the internship guaranteed?
items.answer: Yes. The 3-month internship is part of the program. You work on live client accounts with mentor supervision — real budgets, real deadlines, real results.

items.question: What certifications will I earn?
items.answer: You earn a Digitonix Academy Certificate of Achievement plus module-wise certificates. We also guide you toward official Google and Meta certifications.

items.question: Do you provide placement assistance?
items.answer: Yes. We provide 100% placement assistance including resume preparation, LinkedIn optimization, mock interviews, and referrals through our hiring network until you land a role.

items.question: Are classes online or offline?
items.answer: Both. We offer classroom training at our Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur campus and online training options. You can choose the mode that works best for you.

items.question: What tools and platforms will I learn?
items.answer: You get hands-on practice with 40+ tools including Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, Google Search Console, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, WordPress, Mailchimp, HubSpot, Zapier, and more.

items.question: How are batches structured?
items.answer: We keep batches small and mentor-led. This ensures personal attention, practical feedback, and space for questions — not a lecture hall experience.
